d: A large window from which you can see a stretch of roofs covered with snow. To the left, a fireplace. A table, a bed, a cabinet, a small bookcase, four chairs, a painter's stand with a rough canvas and a stool: scattered books, many bundles of cards, two candlesticks. I go out in the middle, another on the left. Rodolfo looks meditating out of the window. Marcello works at his painting: "The passage of the Red Sea" , with his hands intimidated by the cold and that he warms up breathing on you from time to time, changing, for the great frost, often position.

A cross of streets that takes the form of squares; shops, Sellers of all kinds; on the one hand, the Momus Coffee. THE VIGILIA OF CHRISTMASGran crowd and different: Borghese, Soldiers, Kids, Children, Students, Sartines, Gendarmes, etc.On the limit of their shops the Sellers shout loudly inviting the crowd of 'Buyers. Separated in that great crowd of people they wander Rodolfo and Mimì on one side, Hills at the shop of a Rappezzatrice; Schaunard at a shop of Ferravecchi is composing a pipe and a horn; Marcello pushed here and there by the whim of the people. Several of them at a table outside the Momus Coffee. It is evening. The shops are adorned with lamps and bright lights; a large fanale illuminates the entrance to the coffee.
